summary: APM feed s074_single is degraded due to 20.3% duplicate packets (871 of 4295, threshold 5%). All other checks (one-way traffic, packet drops, VLAN coverage, encrypted share, tool overload) are healthy. Broker deduplication is required to restore accurate APM measurements.

findings.root_cause: Traffic aggregated from multiple SPAN/TAP sources without deduplication - same packets forwarded twice via overlapping capture points to the single APM tool port.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM will double-count transactions, inflate throughput and latency metrics, misclassify duplicates as retransmissions, and waste ~20% of processing capacity on redundant packets.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet broker deduplication to suppress identical packets within a short time window before delivery, removing the 20% duplicate load while preserving both directions needed for APM transaction correlation.
